head_commit.message:
Qualify repaired closed-cache analysis at one exact final source

Record the complete e136 narrow pass: 108 native proof reports, exact 1884 generated matrix, strict body gates, retained controls, and all 1400 mixed assertions / 440 calls within the unchanged cap. Bind all 52 artifact files to run 40033825281 attempt 1.

Restore exactly five final work-branch push triggers and pause the narrow trigger, preserving repaired proof ordering, both 1400/8400 six-shard routes, and all original controls. Keep rejected ce574 research, Arena C failure and profile D findings source-bound. T01F/current A/B/D remain open until their exact scoped gates complete; no integration or general speedup claim.
